notes.title: Patch Notes - 4/27/2016 - Key Binding Added!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

We're excited to announce a new patch adding the ability to bind keys for the controls of 1979 Revolution: Black Friday!

Changelist:


    A controls menu was added (both in the main menu as well as the pause menu) allowing the player to remap keys for all the major controls in game.
    Fixed a variety of minor gameplay bugs.


https://partner.steamgames.com/gfxproxy/gfx/apps/388320/extras/azerty_small.png?t=1461772583

notes.title: Patch Notes - 4/19/2016
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

A patch is now live for 1979 Revolution: Black Friday that fixes and improves a bunch of various issues/bugs we've seen occurring.

Changelist:

The Unity project has been upgraded from Unity 5.2.2 to Unity 5.3.4! This should resolve issues on older graphics cards crashing at scene 1 due to post-processing effects. 
Fixed issues relating to stories and photos being unlockable at the wrong sections of the game. 
Fixed an issue where the player could take a photo in the Black Friday scene before they were intended to, which would make progression behave strangely. 
Fixed an issue where gameplay would continue behind UI if the user entered the stories book from the photo review screen in certain situations. 
Fixed multiple issues regarding users being unable to unlock progress achievements or track stat progress.
Fixed multiple issues regarding blank or mis-firing subtitles. 
Fixed an issue relating to two Steam accounts on the same computer preventing achievement unlocking. 
All rapid tap prompts and the pressure mini-game for a specific character's trauma mini-game can now be performed using the Spacebar key.  Rapid Tap QTE can now be performed with the spacebar key.
Adjusted certain UI elements to prevent buttons or menu items to disappear at 2k+ resolutions due to UI scaling. 
Added UI to inspection camera buttons to better indicate when a object was interactive or not. 
Fixed a variety of minor gameplay bugs.

notes.title: Hours Away from Release!
notes.notes:
We are now less than 12 Hours from the release of 1979 Revolution: Black Friday on Steam!

The game should be going live shortly after 12:00am EST at which point the game will be available to purchase and download immediately.

Again as a reminder the game will be available for a limited time at a discount of $9.95 before going up to $11.99 so make sure to take advantage of that!

Thanks so much to everyone in the Steam community for all the support over the past months (and years!) - we're so happy to be finally sharing this game with you!

http://i.imgur.com/c33V1eA.jpg
